specs.title: an administrator creates a user with a restricted role from the keyboard, and that user sees and can do only what it grants
a role is built in the permission matrix with search and a bulk toggle, then copied and deleted
the Administrator role and the matrix read right to left in Arabic
finds one user by keyboard: the search box has focus, words in any order, Enter opens the only match
moves through rows with the arrow keys, selects with Space and opens with Enter
sorts from a header and filters from the column menu; the address keeps the state
groups by a column with counts and opens a group's rows
chooses columns and saves a personal default view that opens next time
a read-only user keeps personal views but is not offered sharing
the list works right to left in Arabic with Arabic counts and headers
an administrator opens every menu entry in English and each screen loads
an administrator opens every menu entry in Arabic, right to left, and each screen loads

counts take the right plural form in Arabic
signing out returns to the sign-in screen and the session is gone
a fresh visit, with or without a stale session cookie, logs no error and no failed request
switch to Arabic in one click on a working screen: everything mirrors at once, records stay, and it survives an immediate reload
